brief.t: FIRST — Terra Lotus: $78,580, or 52% of the $150K target, has sat unsent since Aug 2. Provide the contact name plus shipping and billing addresses; approve the contract and tiered quote; then send it today. This is the biggest revenue lever — do not start anything else first.

SECOND — Atlas Eternal: $26,500 agreement and pro forma are ready. Confirm Aiden Kraim's Adobe-document wording, fill the size/packaging, billing-address, and lead-time/Incoterms placeholders, then approve and send. Together with Terra, that is $105,080 — 70% of the monthly target.

THIRD — OpenSend needs the noon green light: three lookalike domains, a sending platform, a separate Outbound Agent with its own login, a booking-calendar URL, and ICP Tier A. Every delay pushes the 2–3 week warmup clock.

FOURTH — Restore the PLL CRM session as pll_tasklet_consultant. It blocks CRM fix verification, Aidan purchasing knowledge-base extraction, and UnShrink It verification; do not treat old dashboard numbers as live until access is back.
FIFTH — Aidan Command Lab is live and self-publishing at 7 AM. Aidan still needs to reconnect his own CRM and WhatsApp so the brief captures CRM tasks and supplier chats instead of Outlook only.
SIXTH — Nadia/Oreka: secure approval of the $8,555 payment and keep the 1,000-unit Peptide Cream job moving. This is the next cash-and-production follow-up after the two contracts.

SEVENTH — Clear the warm follow-ups after revenue sends: get Victor Armendarez the packaging, fill, labor, and overhead costing needed for his quote, and complete Tiffany's call before travel. Overnight, H&B replied on a broad multi-product manufacturing inquiry; Sales has sent qualification questions.

OpenSend at noon: approve domains, platform, agent, calendar URL, and ICP Tier A.
Restore the PLL CRM session; then have Aidan reconnect his CRM and WhatsApp.

kb.a: Terra Lotus is a $78,580 manufacturing opportunity, equal to 52% of the $150K monthly target. The contract and tiered quote have been unsent since Aug 2; Sam must provide the contact name plus shipping and billing addresses, approve both documents, and send them today. Nothing should outrank this.

Atlas Eternal is a $26,500 opportunity with its agreement and pro forma ready to send. Before release, confirm Aiden Kraim's Adobe-document wording and complete fill size/packaging, billing address, and lead time/Incoterms. Sam then approves and sends.

OpenSend needs Sam's noon approval for three lookalike domains, a sending platform, a separate PLL Outbound Agent with its own login, a booking calendar URL, and ICP Tier A. The domain and inbox warmup takes about 2–3 weeks, so a delay today delays pipeline creation.

The PLL CRM browser session is signed out at the login screen. Restoring pll_tasklet_consultant access is needed for CRM fix verification, Aidan purchasing knowledge-base extraction, and UnShrink It verification. Today's carried CRM dashboard figures are not live verification.

Aidan Command Lab is live and self-publishing its brief at 7 AM. It still needs Aidan to reconnect his own CRM and WhatsApp so it can incorporate CRM tasks and supplier chats instead of relying on Outlook only.
Nadia/Oreka needs $8,555 payment approval and the next handoff for a 1,000-unit Peptide Cream job. Treat this as the next cash-and-production follow-up once Terra and Atlas are sent.

Victor Armendarez has a 4,000-unit, two-SKU opportunity: Curl Defining Cream and Edge Gel. The quote still needs confirmed packaging, fill, labor, and overhead costs; do not issue pricing until the cost basis is complete.
Tiffany requires a call before travel. The immediate commercial objective and exact timing are not verified in current sources, so confirm both on the call rather than inventing a commitment.

Yorel, founder of Hubs & Babydoll, is a new multi-product manufacturing inquiry covering body oils, beard products, body butter, and body wash. Overnight, Sales requested quantity, inventory budget, formula needs, brand assets, and WhatsApp availability before scheduling a consultation. No value is verified yet.

Hina at Heirloom is seeking frosted-style packaging and has been connected with Laura for container sourcing. Laura offered a Monday or Tuesday 2 PM ET meeting; confirm a time and bring current container options.

Alex at Shopokami has a Thursday August 6, 2 PM ET discovery call for 200 ml private-label beef-tallow body butter. He wants real pricing at 250, 500, and 1,000 units; this is a live meeting, but its value is not verified.
Sam's lane today is Terra Lotus first, Atlas Eternal second, then the noon OpenSend decision. Do not switch to facility or lower-value work until the Terra package is sent.
Aidan owns Atlas inputs, Nadia/Oreka payment progress, and reconnecting his Command Lab sources. His work is constrained by the signed-out CRM session, so restore access early.
Laura is handling qualified inbound follow-up, including H&B qualification and Heirloom container sourcing. Keep this work moving without allowing it to displace the two major contract sends.
Ronald supports the technical and cost confirmation needed for Victor Armendarez. The quote remains blocked until packaging compatibility and full cost inputs are documented.
